chat.author: Błażej Zyglarski
chat.text:
Every AI agent action starts with generated text. At the bottom of the stack, the model produces output, and that output becomes an action. If the system logs and cryptographically signs that generation step from the start, every action can be traced back to its source.
This isn’t only about auditing what my agent did to other systems. It’s about being able to prove to others that the record is complete and hasn’t been altered. Like in insurance companies, which will require such record at some point.
So responsibility should sit with the company that runs the agents, and it should be built into the core of AI execution systems instead of added afterwards.

AAIF is working on this. I have been looking at RFCs 8693, 9396, and 9449 and would love to see across IETF and AAIF.
